newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ man arrested after shooting rampage.
newsitem.headline: NZ man arrested after shooting rampage.

text.p: Police arrested a man who went on a shooting rampage in the central North Island town of Raurimu on Saturday, killing at least one person and wounding up to 10 others, the New Zealand Press Association reported.
The gunman, believed to be a local 50-year-old, was arrested after he fled into bush near the small town following the incident.
Planes and helicopters were called in to help police hunt the man down.
Police said at least one person had been shot dead, NZPA reported. It said up to 10 others had been wounded in the shootout.
A 30-year-old man was shot in the face by the gunman and was flown to Palmerston North Hospital by helicopter. He was suffering moderate injuries and was reported to be in satisfactory condition.
The condition of the other wounded was not immediately known.
At least three rescue helicopters flew the wounded to Palmerston North and Taumarunui Hospitals.
Police told residents the shooting, which began around 9 a.m. (2000 GMT Friday), was related to a domestic incident.
